mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.article_id, c.c_msg, c.user_id, c.c_star, c.c_time, u.nickname as user_com_nick, u.portrait as user_com_img FROM a_comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} ORDER BY c.c_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_comment (article_id, c_msg, user_id, c_star, c_time) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{comMsg}, #{userComId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE a_comment SET c_star = c_star + #{num} WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.reply_id, r.comment_id, r.reply_msg, r.from_user_id, r.to_user_id, r.r_star, r.reply_time, u1.nickname as user_reply_from_nick, u1.portrait as user_reply_img, u2.nickname as user_reply_to_nick FROM a_reply r LEFT JOIN user u1 ON r.from_user_id = u1.user_id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON r.to_user_id = u2.user_id WHERE r.comment_id = #{commentId} ORDER BY r.reply_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_reply (comment_id, reply_msg, from_user_id, to_user_id, r_star, reply_time) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{replyMsg}, #{userReplyFromId}, #{userReplyToId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE a_reply SET r_star = r_star + #{num} WHERE reply_id = #{replyId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a_star WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_id = #{commentId} AND type = 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_star (type_id, type, user_id) VALUES (#{commentId}, 2, #{userId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM a_star WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type_id = #{commentId} AND type = 2
